propositions: A new project-only criterion should direct agents to re-derive incomplete source-reference inventories using Serena's symbol tools rather than manual enumeration.
The criterion must route to plan_review only because project.* criterion ids cannot enter code_review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would create dead moves.
Code-review moves are already overlay-driven via .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring is required; plan-review-only routing changes no shipped src/rebar/ defaults.
The criterion posture must be advisory (default_posture: advisory) with no blocking_enabled key, to coach method rather than gate correctness.

Detection of incomplete inventory via this criterion is demonstrated live at 1.0 validity but cannot reliably reach agent selection because built-in blocking criteria (G1G2, G6, E4) take precedence and the advisory move loses selection.
